purpose: Pre-registered P2-F resolution stage. It adds one independent intermediate velocity group to each factor cell because the completed 80-run P2-F two-speed estimator is non-estimable under complete separation. It must be analysed jointly with the frozen completed P2-F snapshot and must not overwrite it.

parent_snapshot.provenance_note: The parent snapshot records the completed P2-F observations only. It is retained read-only and is never rewritten by this package.

primary_endpoint.name: terminal_projectile_origin_downstream_mass_fraction
primary_endpoint.definition: At the terminal snapshot after the pre-registered approach run plus 5.0 ps NVE recovery, count original projectile atoms (LAMMPS type 4) with z <= -500 Angstrom and divide by the initial projectile atom count.
primary_endpoint.event_definition: A binary event is recorded only when the terminal projectile-origin downstream mass fraction is greater than or equal to 0.50.
primary_endpoint.reporting_name: V_T,50: velocity at which the probability of the pre-registered >=50% projectile-origin downstream mass-transmission event is 0.5.
primary_endpoint.prohibited_name: Do not call this conventional ballistic V50 or an intact-projectile perforation threshold.

analysis_model.name: three-speed grouped binomial logistic regression
analysis_model.critical_boundary: A V_T,50 is reportable only if all four cells have 10/10 valid new resolution runs, at least two distinct velocity groups in each pooled cell have 1–9 events, the pooled parent-plus-resolution grouped logistic fit is finite with positive slope, observed fractions are non-decreasing, and V_T,50 lies inside the tested velocity span. Failure of any condition preserves not_ready and requires a separately preregistered follow-up; no automatic next-round velocity selection is permitted.
